the simulation of the daylighting performance of CFS is feasible, provided the CFS can be accurately modeled and the simulation tool can properly account for the effect of the external luminance on the room's lighting conditions.

, in order to predict the performance level of a CFS, the most accurate approach consists of modeling it in a backward ray-tracer, which can be achieved by integrating measured BTDF data into the simulation tool.
